tools.description: Find retrosynthetic routes for a target molecule back to commercially available building blocks. Uses A* / AND-OR tree search with SMIRKS templates and commercially available building blocks.

avoid_elements.description: Comma-separated elements to exclude from BBs (e.g. "Br,I")

require_elements.description: Elements that must appear in ≥1 building block (e.g. "B")

tools.name: find_routes

tools.description: Find the best retrosynthetic route for a target molecule and validate it: check atom balance of each step (target_MW ≤ Σ precursor_MW) and report confidence/probability scores.
tools.name: validate_route

tools.description: Find retrosynthetic routes for a target and return a human-readable explanation of the top route(s): strengths, weaknesses, and per-step details derived from confidence, success_probability, atom_economy, and reaction_family.
tools.name: explain_route

tools.description: Find retrosynthetic routes for a target and return the Pareto-optimal subset across multiple objectives (route_cost, success_probability, steps, etc.). Each Pareto route is non-dominated — no other route is better on all objectives simultaneously.

max_routes.description: Routes to search before computing Pareto front (default: 10)

tools.name: find_pareto_routes

tools.description: Find retrosynthetic routes applying explicit constraints: avoid elements, require elements, max steps, min confidence, min success probability, preferred reaction families. Designed for LLM-driven synthesis planning (Project Ariadne style).

avoid_elements.description: Comma-separated elements to ban from BBs (e.g. "Br,I")

max_steps.description: Maximum number of synthesis steps per route

prefer_reaction_families.description: Comma-separated reaction families to rank first (e.g. "amide_coupling,suzuki_retro")

require_elements.description: Elements that must appear in ≥1 BB (e.g. "B")

tools.name: plan_with_constraints

tools.description: Find multiple retrosynthetic routes for a target molecule and report the route diversity score (1 - avg pairwise Jaccard similarity of building-block sets). Higher = more diverse options available.
tools.name: estimate_diversity

tools.description: Diagnose why no retrosynthetic route was found for a target molecule. Runs the search and analyses SearchStats to identify likely causes (depth exhausted, no matching templates, beam too narrow, no building block matches) and returns actionable suggestions.
tools.name: diagnose_failure
